messages:
Alice Chen: quick heads-up — while prepping the sprint notes I ran the link-scan and it flagged a few KB issues. can owners claim?

docs-bot: automated link-scan results (2026-03-17 22:10 UTC)
```
1) /docs/runtime/response-caching.md#kv-cache -> anchor not found
2) /docs/quickstarts/model-onboarding.md#s3-perms -> 404
3) /kb/observability/console-dashboard.md -> image 403
```

Priya S: I can take item 1 — looks like the heading was renamed during the last edit. i'll open a tiny PR to restore the anchor or add a redirect. ETA: today EOD PST. :+1:

Alice Chen: thanks priya. the offending link in the scan has the old anchor; re-adding a stable anchor is fine. i can help with the PR review.

marc: ping me when the PR is up, i'll review quickly. small note — prefer adding a frontmatter redirect key so old links keep working if headings change.

Diego M: i'll own item 2 (404). suspect the example S3 path moved when we refactored onboarding. i'll rehost the screenshot and update the path. planning to do this tomorrow morning.

Samir: i'll take item 3 — looks like a CDN permission issue for that image. i'll rehost under assets.redwood-internal and add a tiny smoke test that checks 200 for images referenced in the doc.

Priya S: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4527 — small frontmatter tweak + anchor restore. @marc please review when you have a moment.

marc: reviewing now. left one nit about the anchor name (use `kv-cache` instead of `kv_cache`) — otherwise LGTM. also added a note to add yourself to `owners:` in frontmatter so the doc-scan auto-closes.

docs-bot: friendly reminder — add `owners:` to the doc frontmatter to claim ownership; link-scan will mark the issue resolved once PR merges. :robot_face:

Alice Chen: great. once Diego and Samir are done we should re-run the scan and then close the sprint ticket. i'll add a small recurring chore to the retro to rotate doc triage so this doesn't pile up.

Diego M: created PR for the onboarding path + rehosted image: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4529 — includes tests.

Samir: PR for rehosted image + smoke test: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4530 — adjusted CDN path and alt text.

marc: both PRs look good; queued for merge after CI. thanks y'all. :thumbsup:

Alice Chen: thanks team — marking this thread as tracked in the sprint ticket. if anyone needs help with redirects or frontmatter format i can pair briefly.

Priya S: small follow-up: i'll add a one-liner in the docs contribution guide about not renaming headings without a redirect. saving future pain.
